SpellCheck__Meta.Meta__Description: The Spell Check feature: TrueVision's text boxes checked by the browser's own spell check, with the practice's dictionary of words it must never mark - manufacturers, product names, trade words - kept in 50__TrueVision__UserConfig/TrueVision__UserSpellings__.json at the app root. Owned by 02__Src__AppModules/55__Feature__SpellCheck (Na__SpellCheck__.js is the one door in).

SpellCheck__Dictionary.Dictionary__Description: Where the dictionary is and how a word is matched against it. File is relative to the TrueVision app root (the folder Index.html is in); ApiPath is the ProjectVision local server's route for Add to Dictionary. A word matches in any case; AcceptPossessive also takes it with 's, AcceptPlural with a plural s or es. Enabled false leaves every word to the browser's own spell check, dictionary words included.

SpellCheck__Field.Field__Description: The spell-checked text box. UndoMergeMs: typing within this long of the last change is one undo step (Ctrl+Z inside the box undoes its own typing, never the drawing's). The box keeps its own history because it re-marks the dictionary's words as they are typed, which the browser's own undo cannot follow.

SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__Description: Every word the feature shows. {tokens} are filled in by the module. The curly quotes are part of the wording.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__AddWordTitle: Add {word} to the TrueVision spelling dictionary (50__TrueVision__UserConfig/TrueVision__UserSpellings__.json), so it is never marked as a spelling mistake again.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__RemoveTitle: Take {word} out of the TrueVision spelling dictionary. It was added from the app; the browser will check it again.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__NoWord: Put the caret in a word to add it to the dictionary.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__ReadOnly: Words can be added to the dictionary only with the ProjectVision local server.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__Restart: Restart the ProjectVision local server to add words to the dictionary.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__Unreadable: Words cannot be added until the dictionary file is put right: {reason}. Correct it in 50__TrueVision__UserConfig, then reload TrueVision.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__Added: Added “{word}” to the TrueVision dictionary. It is not marked again, in any box.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__AlreadyThere: “{word}” is already in the TrueVision dictionary.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__Removed: Took “{word}” out of the TrueVision dictionary.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__NotRemoved: “{word}” was not in the dictionary on its own, so nothing was taken out.
SpellCheck__Labels.Labels__NotAWord: “{word}” is not one word. A dictionary word is letters and digits, with an apostrophe inside it if it needs one.
